deploybot: Rollout rbld/inference:20260610-hotfix auto-paused in eu-central due to elevated embed 5xxs. Requesting manual disposition. Logs: https://internal.logs/1765439998 :rotating_light:

tara: Copy. Is this the kv-cache boundary bug again or something new?

lee: Seen similar signal in canary traces. Appears to surface when sequence length > 1024 on quant path.

amir: Pulling metrics now. 10m window: +2.6% 5xx in eu-central, p99 tokens increased. Heatmap -> embed-node-9.

jess: Product impact? Customers seeing degraded quality or errors?

lee: Mostly service fallbacks, not quality regressions. Fallbacks spike user latency.

ops-bot: Suggested actions: [rollback-region], [pin-patch-small-canary], [divert-traffic]. Which?

tara: Prefer smallest blast radius. Option: divert embed traffic from eu-central, push micro-patch that disables the problematic kernel for node-9, then 5% manual canary.

amir: I can do traffic diversion now. Command: `rbctl traffic shift --service=embeddings --from=eu-central --to=eu-fallback --percentage=100 --confirm`

deploybot: Action logged: traffic-shift executed by amir at 2026-06-10T01:12:10Z. Rollout paused.

lee: Building rbld/inference:20260610-hotfix.1 (node-9 kernel flag off). ETA ~18m.

tara: When image ready, request manual pin to eu-central at 5%. Approval here required for expedited pin.

lee: Patch pushed. Pin request: `deploybot pin --image=rbld/inference:20260610-hotfix.1 --scope=eu-central --percentage=5 --reason="node-9 kernel toggle"`

tara: +1 from me for 5% canary if SRE sets abort: embed-5xx > baseline+0.5% for 10m -> immediate rollback. @amir please confirm.

amir: Confirmed and alerting in place. Dashboard: https://dashboards/internal/embeds-eu-central

jess: I'll publish a short internal note for support and product with rollback instructions.

deploybot: Manual pin recorded. Starting 5% canary now.

amir: 12m in, no new 5xxs. Holding to 30m per playbook.

tara: Good work. If 30m clean -> ramp to 50% then 100% with normal cadence. If abort, rollback to rbld/inference:20260601-stable.

lee: Will capture timeline for postmortem after stabilization.
